subject: Re: Acme - Access ownership trace & SSO/SCIM artifacts
messages:
From: Alex Durand <alex.durand@acme-industries.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: security@acme-industries.com, procurement@acme-industries.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Access inventory and SSO artifacts needed for SIG/CAIQ

Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team is starting a SIG/CAIQ pass and they need a short access-related artifact bundle to complete the review. Can you provide the following by EOD Tuesday (11/3)?

- SCIM delta export for the last 30 days (add timestamps and username/email, include source of change)
- A sample SAML authentication assertion (with any PII redacted) showing NameID + common attributes
- RBAC role ownership matrix mapping role -> privileges -> role owner contacts
- A one-paragraph least-privilege attestation we can include in the SIG response

We are prepared to sign an NDA if you prefer; let me know if any of this requires a PO/procurement item.

Appreciate the quick turn — Alex
Alex Durand
Head of Security Engineering
Acme Industries
security@acme-industries.com

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Acme - Access inventory and SSO artifacts needed for SIG/CAIQ

Naomi / Priyom — forwarding Acme's request. They want a compact bundle (SCIM deltas, SAML sample, RBAC ownership, attestation) by EOD Tue 11/3. No legal redlines yet but they mentioned NDA/PO.

Plan:
- Naomi: export SCIM deltas (CSV) covering 2026-10-01 -> 2026-10-31, include change source (SCIM/API/console) and actor email. Please scrub any full access tokens and redact IPs. Put CSV on the internal Drive link and attach stub here.
- Priyom: generate role-ownership matrix from provisioning service (roles, permissions, owner) and prepare a short least-privilege attestation paragraph. See quick template below.
- Marissa: if procurement asks for a PO, coordinate; also prepare the SAML assertion sample with PII redacted (replace NameID with <redacted-nameid>).

Deadline: package + draft attestation into the Drive folder by 11/03 17:00 PST. If we need to push to Tuesday morning, tell Acme asap.

Template attestation (draft) to adapt: "Redwood Inference confirms that role assignments for Acme Industries are scoped to least privilege based on documented role definitions; changes to role assignments are performed via SCIM or console by authorized administrators, and an audit trail is retained for review."

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02T08:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acme - Access inventory and SSO artifacts needed for SIG/CAIQ

Attaching the SCIM delta export and a small readme. Notes:
- File: acme_scim_delta_2026-10-logs.csv (attached) — columns: timestamp, username, email, action, source, changed_by
- Redactions applied: removed remote IP addresses and masked any user identifier that matched our internal admin UUIDs; left customer usernames/emails intact per their request.
- Export includes "source" values (SCIM, console, api) so they can see provisioning origin.

I uploaded the original export to the internal Drive folder (link below) and attached the redacted CSV for sending.

Drive: https://drive.redwood/internal/ACME/scim-deltas
Attachment: acme_scim_delta_2026-10-logs.csv (text/csv)

Naomi
Security Operations Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02T11:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acme - Access inventory and SSO artifacts needed for SIG/CAIQ

I've prepared:
- role-ownership-matrix-ACME.csv (attached) — columns: role_id, role_name, permission_list, owner_name, owner_email, last_reviewed
- saml-assertion-sample-20261029.txt (attached) — assertion with NameID replaced by <redacted-nameid>, attribute values kept but PII removed
- least-privilege-attestation-draft.docx (attached) — one-paragraph attestation adapted from Marcus' template, plus a short signature line for me (Customer Security Lead)

Quick points: we will include a note that we retain audit logs for 365 days for SCIM provisioning events and that role changes require 2FA for admin console or service account with scoped SCIM tokens. Naomi's CSV shows change actors for all role modifications.

Attachments: role-ownership-matrix-ACME.csv (text/csv), saml-assertion-sample-20261029.txt (text/plain), least-privilege-attestation-draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Marissa Cole
Customer Security Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Durand <alex.durand@acme-industries.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: security@acme-industries.com, procurement@acme-industries.com
Date: 2026-11-03T16:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Acme - Access ownership trace & SSO/SCIM artifacts

Marcus / team — thanks for the fast turnaround and thorough files. A couple quick follow-ups:

- Can you confirm that token values were redacted and that the SAML sample contains no session identifiers?
- We'll need a signed attestation (PDF) from Redwood Security or Customer Security lead that we can attach to the SIG. Marissa's draft looks good — can you produce a signed PDF?

If it's easier, let's hop on a 20-minute call tomorrow morning to sign off. Procurement will confirm whether a PO is required for the sharing of redacted audit logs.

Appreciate it — Alex
